title: Egyptian-Style Pomegranate Salad
description: A refreshing and flavorful salad inspired by Egyptian cuisine, featuring crisp greens, fresh vegetables, and tangy pomegranate seeds.
instructions: 1. In a large bowl, massage the kale with your hands for about 2 minutes to help tenderize it.
2. Add the sliced cucumber, pomegranate seeds, and chopped mint to the bowl with the kale.
3. Squeeze the lemon juice over the salad and toss to combine.
4. If desired, drizzle with olive oil and toss again.
5. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
6. Serve immediately, garnished with additional mint leaves if desired.
